name: goldtrace-ghana
description: National Gold Supply Chain Intelligence & Traceability System (GoldBod)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix mobile install && pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.backend:worker: cd backend && celery -A goldtrace worker -l info
scripts._note: frontend and mobile are independent installs; no npm workspaces (React Native must not share React with the web app)
